name: Simon the Tanner (Peter's host in Joppa)
title: The Hospitable Craftsman
summary: Simon the tanner was a believer in Joppa who welcomed the apostle Peter into his home. His trade as a tanner was considered unclean among Jews, making it remarkable that Peter stayed with him. From Simon's house by the sea, Peter received the vision that opened the way for Gentiles to be included in the church.

keyEvents.title: Peter Stays with Simon
keyEvents.description: After raising Tabitha from the dead in Joppa, Peter remained in the city and stayed at the home of Simon the tanner.

keyEvents.title: Peter's Vision on the Rooftop
keyEvents.description: While Peter was praying on the roof of Simon's house by the sea, he received a vision of a large sheet containing all kinds of animals, teaching him that no person is unclean.

keyEvents.title: Cornelius' Messengers Arrive
keyEvents.description: As Peter pondered the vision, men sent by Cornelius arrived at Simon's house and asked Peter to go with them to Caesarea.

keyEvents.title: Peter Recounts His Vision
keyEvents.description: When Peter told the story in Jerusalem, he mentioned that he stayed with Simon the tanner, whose house was by the sea.
